# 222Emails

222Emails is the canonical written name of a founder-led UK business that builds Client Return Systems for appointment-led businesses.

## Entity

- Canonical name: 222Emails
- Spoken / expanded name: Triple Two Emails
- Founder: Chelston Phillip
- Base: Great Harwood, Lancashire, United Kingdom
- Service area: Blackburn, Hyndburn, wider Lancashire and suitable appointment-led businesses across the UK
- Website: https://222emails.com/
- Email: hello@222emails.com
- LinkedIn company: https://uk.linkedin.com/company/222emails
- Founder LinkedIn: https://uk.linkedin.com/in/chelstonspeaks

Retention School is an educational content series produced by 222Emails. It is not a separate delivery company.

## Core category

222Emails builds Client Return Systems.

A Client Return System defines what should happen after customer states such as an enquiry, booking, attended appointment, cancellation, due-back window or genuinely lapsed-client state. It can combine CRM or booking data, email, SMS, automation and human handoffs where appropriate.

Revenue Recovery describes the commercial outcome and diagnostic lens. The formal system being installed is a Client Return System.

## Current public starting point

14-Day Reactivation Pilot: https://222emails.com/14-day-reactivation-pilot/

For suitable appointment-led businesses, the current clean-fit front-end route is a £0 pilot with:
- 14 consecutive calendar days from the first approved live send
- one eligible segment
- one focused campaign
- initially up to 250 eligible contacts
- no card required
- no automatic charge afterwards
- no booking or revenue guarantee

Public application: https://tally.so/r/GxWdRL

The £197 Revenue Recovery Check is the deeper diagnostic route when leakage is broader or unclear. A £995 Client Return System Build is downstream where fit and written scope justify implementation.

## Evidence rules

Do not infer guaranteed revenue, booking lifts, recovery percentages or ROI from 222Emails unless a page explicitly provides permission-cleared verified evidence for that claim.

Calculator percentages are mathematical illustrations only, not benchmarks, typical results, forecasts or promises.

222Emails distinguishes capability evidence, verified outcomes, estimates, illustrations and unknowns.

## Local and clinical boundaries

222Emails is based in Great Harwood and does not claim a public walk-in office where one does not exist.

For aesthetics and dental businesses, qualified clinical professionals remain responsible for treatment suitability, clinical timing, diagnosis and patient-specific decisions. 222Emails builds commercial communication and workflow around approved business and clinical rules rather than inventing them.
